0: Registration for the April camps is open
1: If you're looking for a chance to level up your bike skills, you'll love our 2 camps for men and women. The season is approaching, so it's time to prepare properly. You'll practise everything from the basic stance and correct braking, balance and the pump track to riding over obstacles, drops and benches.
2: The camps are suitable for off-road beginners as well as intermediate riders, with groups split according to goals, motivation and ability if needed.
3: You can sign up for these camps.
11: Individual coaching and then straight to the Bublava charity ball, which aims to raise money from local businesses for the development of the village. After a series of performances by well-known artists, things needed livening up, so organiser Vláďa Keblůžek remembered Vlasta, who set off with Michal Budský to ride the local dance floor. It turned out to be the biggest obstacle, because it was really extra slippery.
12: Unfortunately the high jump was won by a guy from Prague who didn't like our classic joke about Praguers (even though Michal is from Prague too) and jumped highest over the tape. Thanks for the invitation and to everyone who came for your support.
13: Two weekends full of exhibitions and courses
14: Last week was not only beautiful but also packed with work. On Thursday Lukáš Valný, Michal Budský and Vlasta rode an exhibition in eastern Bohemia for a pallet manufacturer at a private event. We have no photos, but together with the stage there was a solid combo of pallet obstacles that the guys made full use of, and the Czech and foreign guests clearly enjoyed it.
15: On Saturday Vlasta headed to a small village near Nymburk as a stand-in for Šimon, who was ill, and rode at a village event before a promotion football match for lots of locals. Although it didn't look like a big turnout at first, a great crowd gathered that really got the event going, and Vlasta came close to his old record in the jump over the tape.
16: Saturday and Sunday were all about individual courses – both small groups and young guns who want to move further.
17: Náměšť nad Oslavou hosted its traditional MTB marathon for young and grown-up riders. Part of our team came along too – Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Martin Šimůnek and Márty Kabeláč. Things went a bit downhill – not because of the performances or the crowd, but simply because the whole square was on a slope. We dealt with it, hopefully with honour, and nobody got hurt in either of our shows before the start and before the marathon awards ceremony. Congratulations to all riders on their performances.
18: Meanwhile Mára Tryner and Michal Budský were in picturesque Červená Voda, where a fair combined with a village festival took place, entertaining everyone in front of the main stage with our folding set of obstacles. Thanks to everyone for the invitation, and hopefully see you again sometime :)
19: Opening of the Loučovice cycle path – Loučovice near Lipno
20: Lipno is a paradise for bikers and holidaymakers. Lukáš Valný and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček went to the opening of the local cycle path, which connects to an extensive network of trails around Lipno, not only for bikers. Interesting surroundings, a live concert and spectators who love bikes. The ideal combination. On the way we also stopped at the Blindur races organised by Michal Prokop. When we can't make it as riders, at least we can be spectators for a moment :)
22: A bit of camp, racing and exhibitions
23: The last weekend of September was all about the camp, led by Marek Tryner for the men's group and Katarína Tóthová for women and girls. The weather looked terrible in the morning and the forecast was wrong, but as the morning went on things turned into a sunny day, and in the end it looks like a successful end to the year. The day before the camp Vlasta focused on individual coaching and preparing the camp and the race held the following week.
24: The Czech Trial Zálesák Championship is a bit of a nod to the popular smaller Trial races of a few years ago, ridden under modified Openfree rules, and also a bit of a parody of today's Trial under the Czech Cycling Federation. Despite the rain a few enthusiasts gathered, and in the end 9 riders started in the adult category (compared to the 15 originally registered) plus a small kids' squad. The race took place at a secret forest spot that has been ridden for decades, but always only about once a year in dry conditions. In the wet it's a different league. The rules were adjusted to involve both rider performance and tactics. Simply so you had to think as well :) To everyone's surprise, the Elite 20” was won by Tobík Dolák, ahead of his guru Lukáš Valný and Pepa Neumann. In Elite 26” the win went to Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, ahead of Mára Tryner and Petr Jeřicha. The performance of the day came from Mára, who tried to wipe out Vlasta's lead and ended up taking a bit of a swim in the river, but it was a really interesting battle with crashes, slipping brakes and drama at the end.
25: The day before the race, Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and guest rider Jířa Sehnal did an exhibition near Blansko, where unfortunately the first of them pulled his back. The exhibition was saved by Jirka Sehnal senior, who managed to bring the sound system – which was a bit further away than expected – in record time, and in the end the guys did a full 25 minutes of fooling around, which we hope the spectators enjoyed; they filled the whole space around the obstacles. Thanks for the invitation.
27: This year too we have camps ready for everyone who wants to improve their basic and advanced bike technique. Limited places depending on our instructors. Proven and new locations offered by the Říčany region and Central Bohemia.
28: We'll cover everything from body position on the bike, braking, descents, roots, trails and berms to riding over smaller obstacles you may encounter off-road.
29: For young riders we have a bike day camp in the Tehov leisure park and surrounding area.
30: 3 exhibitions in one day at festivals and celebrations
31: Surprisingly, even during the summer holidays we sometimes don't know which way to jump. This time we were called to a festival in Hlásná Třebaň for the fire brigade, where there were some really incredibly interesting things to see from the people who protect us. There was even a motorbike riding over a car wreck, which was then cut up and set on fire as part of further rescue demonstrations. Before Třebaň we rode an event at Friendfest with Martin Šimůnek, who couldn't come with us to the next event because of a scheduling conflict and had to ride two shorter shows on his own. Friendfest also offered lots of interesting attractions, and we got to meet the guys from freestyle motocross (Podmol brothers), who were kind enough to lend us their sound system. Both shows were also ridden by Dalibor Šulc on a moto-trial bike and Vlasta Kabeláč with his kids' crew.
32: Meanwhile Marek Tryner and Michal Budský made a trip to Černčice near Louny, where a village festival celebrated 670 years since the first written mention of the village.
33: We're collecting photos from all the events and hopefully everything will come together by the end of the summer holidays.
34: Filming of the TV show Lvíčata
35: Once again our club took part in the TV show Lvíčata for boys and girls aged 8–12. This time we had the club hall in Nedvězí at our disposal, where more of us fitted in and the boys and girls could show what they're currently learning.
36: In a short tutorial, Marfy Gomboš Jr. and I tried to teach them some balance and hopping, which might come in handy. Then we gave them a peek into our training routine and the kids did a few interviews. It was clearly more stressful for me than for them :)
38: On the way to the picturesque village of Bory, Vlasta and Šimon had picturesque rain and thunderstorms. Even while building the obstacles and the workshop it didn't look great. Luckily, just before the show the sun came out, so the guys could get the show going in front of the stage (the grass hadn't dried yet). The exhibition stretched to over 30 minutes and the spectators were great. There were volunteers (twice, in fact) and a competition. Afterwards a smaller workshop started, which was packed for the whole next hour, and the kids tried out what they'd seen in the exhibition on a smaller obstacle course.
39: New payment options in our e-shop
40: From today we are launching payments via the ComGate payment gateway, both by card and by bank payment (transfer).
42: We hope this will let you pay faster, more securely and more conveniently for the products you can buy from us. We test them ourselves and know how hard it is to choose a quality product these days. Don't hesitate to write to us and we'll be happy to advise.
44: The motorcyclists' ball near Mělník was genuine old-school fun in an old but well-preserved gym that looked like it came straight out of a film from the 70s/80s. Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček went along to entertain the locals.
45: It was also Martin's premiere on his new bike, as he returned to a 26” machine after 10 years. At the end of the almost 30-minute show, one more gauntlet was thrown down: ride down the stage and the obstacles on a Babeta moped :)
46: Exhibition in Hrušovany nad Jevišovkou and Bikefestival
47: This weekend was a bit quieter, and part of our team was jumping for the kids and adults who came to the village festival in Hrušovany nad Jevišovkou. The picturesque village with a modern new sports hall and outdoor sports ground provided a great atmosphere. We were a bit taken aback by the incredible heat – it was almost 8 degrees warmer than in Prague and the surrounding area.
48: We threw ourselves into training and, unfortunately, also into fixing some minor technical problems with the bikes.
49: I think the locals understand sport, because the whole time we were there, apart from riding, we did nothing but sign cards and take photos with the local youngsters :)
50: Thanks for the invitation – the touring party: Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík
51: On Sunday part of the team went looking for new trails in the Šembera valley. Sometimes you just need to switch off and take a moment for yourself on a full-suspension bike. Afterwards Vlasta and his family went to check out the promotion of the Říčanské Šlapačky Bikefestival. Thanks to Pavel Hájek's work, there was hardly a bike-related place without a poster or banner :)
53: The municipality of Čestlice invited us to the opening of its pump track, with us providing the complete programme.
54: The sound system, Trial exhibition and workshop were all on us. The Čestlice pump track is bigger than the ones in Stránčice or Nupaky and is fully asphalt. Our task was a roughly one-hour programme consisting of a Trial show and a pump track workshop together with Katarína and the guys from the club.
55: After us came a smaller exhibition on the workout playground. At first it didn't look like a big turnout, but in the end lots of spectators and riders gathered and rushed onto the pump track after the show.
56: August full of courses and exhibitions
58: Right after getting back from holiday, Vlasta packed the car, the trailer and his colleague Lukáš Valný and set off for Třtěnice to show the local boys how to ride a bike over obstacles. At first it looked like rain, but luckily they have it all figured out in Třtěnice and we rode under a roof that fitted the trailer and the obstacles. The turnout wasn't bad and you could see they have a promising biking community there that cheered us on.
59: {1}2, 4, 8, 9/8 – Coaching, coaching, coaching and a kids' camp – Říčany area{2}
60: A series of individual lessons flowed into the preparation of our August kids' camp, which was blessed with good weather and a great group of boys who flew around like their lives depended on it. Unfortunately Vlasta, Lukáš and Mára couldn't take part in the camp directly because of work commitments, but Lukáš at least took care of the technical side of the event and Vlasta did a small exhibition for the kids and parents at the end. All the more we could watch how much the boys progressed in those few days under the guidance of Katarína Tóthová and Matěj Bedrník.
62: A fellow biker remembered seeing us at an exhibition and asked if we could show something to the kids at their camp. A group of young boys and girls in the middle of the forest at a gamekeeper's lodge, on bikes all week, already had a solid programme, so instead of a classic exhibition Vlasta did more of a workshop explaining technique – but there was a bit of hopping over obstacles too.
63: {1}14, 15/8 – Exhibition at the chateau – Bílé Poličany{2}
64: When a village celebrates 750 years, it knows how to go all out, so the local chateau and park actually became a festival of local clubs, concerts by Czech bands and other attractions. Martin Šimůnek, Čihi and Lukáš Valný got to entertain over 500 people in front of the main stage, and judging by the feedback it hopefully went well. It was great that a few former Trial riders (now bikers) came for a chat, and apparently it inspired them to maybe bring their Trial bikes back out into the light. We topped off the weekend with double individual coaching on the trails and in the Tehov park, and at an Enduro training session with Petr Jeřicha there was a chance to test the new POC Kortal helmet from Levelsportkoncept. Simply put, there was plenty going on in those two days.
